# Models
## Choosing a model
If you're not sure where to start, use GPT-6.2 Astra , our flagship model for complex reasoning and coding. Choose GPT-6.2 Sol to balance intelligence and cost, or GPT-6 Luna for cost-sensitive, high-volume workloads.
Learn more in our model selection guide
All latest OpenAI models support text and image input, text output, multilingual capabilities, and vision. Models are available via the Responses API and our Client SDKs .
